rules.logic: BIOC(ITDR-007 LSASS Process Handle Open By Non-System Process) OR BIOC(ITDR-007 Abnormal DACL Write To AdminSDHolder Or Privileged Group) OR BIOC(ITDR-007 Kerberos Relay To LDAP From Local Host (KrbRelayUp)) OR BIOC(ITDR-007 SeImpersonate Named-Pipe Privilege Escalation To SYSTEM) OR BIOC(ITDR-007 Access Token Theft And Impersonation Via Token Duplication) — groups credential access, ACL abuse, Kerberos relay, SeImpersonate escalation, and token theft from one host into a single Privilege Escalation incident.
rules.name: AD Local-to-SYSTEM Privilege Escalation & Token Manipulation Chain From One Host
